incident.cause: The exact owner-approved apply and database postflight completed before the legacy stable-OOS state guard re-read the new state without the already-applied decision context.

correction.shared_runtime: A sealed retailer-neutral applied-stock transition is passed into fresh-source idempotency. It permits only the exact already-approved after-state and does not widen an ordinary threshold.
correction.reporting: Failed batch reports retain the pessimistic non-zero write count instead of reporting zero after a possibly committed apply.
correction.future_evidence: POSTFLIGHT_PASSED is recorded before idempotency so a later source or state-guard failure cannot erase the proven business outcome.
correction.control_recovery: The existing queue workflow gains one mutually exclusive recovery input. It downloads the original immutable artifact, repeats database postflight and fresh-source idempotency, then calls one control-only RPC. It never invokes registration, approval or execution.

next_gate: Finish quick/full verification and CI. Production migration deployment and the exact recovery dispatch remain separate owner-authorized actions.
